rationale: Source explanation closes only the early-acknowledgment suspicion: successful sink finalization and real restore completion precede receiver success, and the sender guards match registration. A delayed or failing restore cannot produce the counted successful acknowledgment through this code path. No execution Evidence or full snapshot correctness claim is created. Snapshot freshness remains another valuable direction requiring a legal sender/follower prefix, while network partial-decode consequences need a distinct fault witness.
